retained_phase7_benchmark.test_integrity_note: Metrics are retained held-out Phase 7 test measurements; Phase 26 did not tune or retrain.

task_definition.relevance: the image associated with the query caption is relevant
task_definition.metric_note: Recall@K and rank statistics are primary; precision is optional and secondary

protocol.candidate_filter: declared candidate corpus; ranked list may be truncated
protocol.precision_definition: hits in the returned prefix divided by K; omitted candidates count as non-hits
protocol.average_precision_definition: AP uses the declared relevance set as denominator over the returned ranked list; report is truncated when the list is truncated
protocol.query_filter: queries with declared relevance are evaluated; no-relevance queries are reported separately
protocol.rank_statistic: first relevant rank; misses are counted separately and excluded from hit-rank mean/median

task_definition.relevance: all legitimate captions associated with the query image are relevant
task_definition.metric_note: Recall@K and first-relevant rank handle multiple relevant captions
